profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at BRUKER
profile.summary:
Versatile, hard-working and optimistic Software Engineer with 9 years of experience designing and developing complex systems. Experienced Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the semiconductors industry specifically Photomask Repair and wafer clean systems.
Highly skilled in problem-solving and developing hardware instrumentation based on microcontrollers, microprocessor FPGA and SoC devices. Skilled in software development with multiple programming languages like C/C++, C#, JAVA, Python, REXX, etc.
Sociable, ready to learn, team-oriented professional with vastly experience on development of equipment and tools for Semiconductor Foundries.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Communication, Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) and +10 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Main developer for the Femto-Pulse Laser Photomask Repair System solution.
• Software development of Windows, Linux application and services.
• System-on-Chip Development for Nanomaching Equipment. Embedded Software development on Zynq SoC (Xilinx FPGA and ARM Cortex A9).
• Development and sustaining of Human-machine interface(HMI) based in Java for photomask repair equipment solutions.
• Labview development for high density acquisition, logging and plotting for Atomic Force Microscopy repair equipment data analysis.
• REXX script development for production and R&D process analysis.
• Embedded Linux development(Petalinux).
• Enabled a low cost manual operated mask loader creating a low entry cost variant of Laser Photomask Repair System equipment.
• Enabled EUV mask repair capabilities in Laser Photomask Repair System equipment.
• Made possible the integration of deposition based mask repair solution to our existing product

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Enabled the shipping in time of the first 6th Generation AFM Guided Nanomachine equipment.
• Software development of Windows and Linux services.
• Development and sustaining of Human-machine interface(HMI) based in Java for photomask repair equipment solutions.
• Labview development for high density data acquisition, logging and plotting for Atomic Force Microscopy repair equipment data analysis.
• REXX script development for production and R&D process analysis.
• Software interfaces and wrappers to integrate devices with multiples protocol including USB, UART, SPI, I2C, HTTP, MODBUS, ethercat, devicenet, etc.
• Image processing for AFM data analysis.

company.name: Universidad Tecnólogica de La Habana "Jose Antonio Echeverría", CUJAE

positions.title: Electronics and Computer Engineer / Teaching assistant
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed prototype for analog/digital electronic communication devices, sensor and systems.
•	Debugged and troubleshot complex analog, digital, and RF circuits.
•	Maintained and managed network environment including troubleshooting, filing and archiving.
•	Managed numerous projects simultaneously within budgetary restrictions.
•	Developed a wireless low power sensor's design based in BLE and ZigBee technologies to acquire small mammal’s EKG and EMG signals.
•	Designed and developed an analog front-end interfaces for conditioning biopotential signals.
•	Lectured microcontrollers and Circuit analysis and design course in the Automation and Control engineering undergraduate program.

positions.title: Electronics and Computer Engineer (Intern)
positions.description:
•	Developed a digital system to sense EKG and EMG in humans and mammals using algorithms to minimize the power consumption.
•	Implemented algorithms in MATLAB and C to determine the hearth rate using the EKG signal.
•	Developed digital systems to control humidity and temperature using embedded systems based in MCUs, CPUs and/or PLCs .
•	Lectured C/C++ Programming course in the Automation and Control Engineering undergraduate program.
